crime: Every night at nine, a girl stood at the upper railing and sent all the prisoners a photo of the fountain in the courtyard below. It was her goodnight. {WITCH_NAME} always answered first, and only then went to sleep.

One night, just before nine, the girl held up her phone to {WITCH_NAME} in the recreation room. "From tomorrow, you send the goodnight. You know the words." Then she stepped out to the railing with it.
Long ago, {WITCH_NAME}'s mother had made her say goodnight alone. "So you can say it without me." By morning, her mother was gone.

At nine, just as the girl's goodnight photo went out, {WITCH_NAME} caught her by the knees and tipped her over the railing. The girl fell headfirst onto the stone path. Then {WITCH_NAME} used her Magic and rewound everything around her to the moment before she had left her chair. She was sitting in it again, and only she remembered. The Magic did not reach the courtyard a floor below. The girl stayed where she had fallen.

In the recreation room, the prisoners had seen the girl step out. From nine until the body was found at 9:40, they saw {WITCH_NAME} sit in her chair and never leave it. That night, none of their phones received a goodnight photo. In the trial court, they concluded that the girl had gone over before she could send it, while {WITCH_NAME} sat with them.

Then one prisoner showed the court her phone. It had been downstairs in the lounge, and the goodnight photo had arrived on it at nine. The prisoners realized that every phone upstairs had been rewound after the photo came. {WITCH_NAME} had been at the railing.
fields.epitaph: Her last goodnight reached every phone but the one that always answered first.
execution: The execution stand raises an iron clock over the trial court. She is collared to its face at the nine, and its hand is a blade.
The hand sweeps toward nine and springs back. It sweeps again and springs back again, turned back over and over.
Then it passes through nine and does not turn back.
The hand comes to rest at nine. The clock strikes once. She hangs still in the collar.

magic.name: Just a Moment Ago
magic.text: She rewinds everything around her by a few moments, and only she remembers.
